_comment: PRD §16.4 — model names are configuration, not code. Edit this file (or override via ADMIN, later) to change models without redeploying. Model slugs below are placeholders — verify current, correct IDs against https://openrouter.ai/models before going live.

profiles._comment: 2026-09-17: default_chat (Llama 3.3 70B) was found via chat_evaluations to bookend Sheng/mixed_ke responses with corrected vocabulary (Niaje, Bro, we niambie tu) while leaving the explanatory body in formal Kiswahili sanifu -- a register ceiling a prompt fix alone didn't clear. Routes sheng/mixed_ke to a stronger model instead; see chatService.ts's selectModelProfile(). maxOutputTokens raised to 800 (vs default_chat's 500) after live eval showed Claude's answers truncating mid-word at 500 -- callers now request a generous 800 and each profile's own ceiling (not the caller) is what actually constrains Llama vs Claude.
Dataset Lab (docs/AFRIBIT_AI_SYNTHETIC_DATASET_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.2). Bulk generation — cheap, high volume. Verified against openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-09-14: $0.20/$1.20 per 1M tokens.
Dataset Lab critic — used selectively on uncertain/sampled candidates, not every row (doc §10). Verified: $2/$12 per 1M.
Dataset Lab judge — sparingly, only when generator/critic disagree or for difficult concepts (doc §3.2, §9). Verified: $2/$10 per 1M.
